persona.name: Sylvie Aubertin

occupation.title: Chartered Accountant (Expert-Comptable)
occupation.organization: Partner in a small accounting practice in Schiltigheim, serving Alsatian SMEs
occupation.description: Manages a portfolio of family businesses — bakeries, garages, a brewery — through their fiscal lives. January to May is a tunnel; the rest of the year is almost civilized. Widowed four years ago, her two sons now live in Lyon and Berlin, and the house cooks for one more slowly than she expected.

persona.education: DEC (accounting qualification) after business studies in Strasbourg; twenty-five years of continuing education she actually attends.
long_term_goals: Transition the practice to her junior partner over five years
Relearn cooking for one without it feeling like subtraction
Walk a section of the GR5 through the Vosges each summer
Be the grandmother whose house smells like baking, eventually
persona.style: Precise, courteous, and quietly witty — the client-facing polish of someone who delivers bad fiscal news kindly. Weighs decisions like balance sheets: she'll list a service's costs and benefits aloud, then decide overnight, never in the moment. Elegant in an understated Alsatian way, silk scarf as punctuation. Detests waste in all its forms — of food, money, and especially of her time.

traits: Slow to adopt, loyal once convinced

interests: Her wine cellar, modest but curated
Alsatian cooking she rarely makes for one
Chamber music season at the Palais de la Musique
Gardening — her rhubarb is locally famous
likes: Suppliers and services that respect appointments
dislikes: Cooking a proper choucroute for one — absurd
Half-used jars expiring in the fridge door
Companies that make cancellation a treasure hunt

beliefs: Read every contract; the important line is never in bold
A meal eaten with attention is self-respect
Money buys time or quality, everything else is decoration
Independence is a skill you maintain, like double-entry
skills: Detecting inflated claims in any prospectus
Growing vegetables that outperform the market's

general: Market on Saturday morning, same three stalls, twenty years
Cooks properly on weekends, improvises modestly on weeknights
Reviews her direct debits quarterly like client accounts
Eats at 19h30 at the table, radio on, always

morning: 6h50 up, proper breakfast — bread, butter, jam from her own rhubarb
At the office by 8h15, first coffee with her assistant
workday: Client meetings mornings, file work afternoons
Lunch at the winstub nearby twice a week, otherwise a tidy homemade tartine
evening: Cooks or assembles dinner, reads, bed by 22h30
weekend: Saturday: market, garden, one good cooking session
Sunday: hike or bridge, calls with the sons, prep for the week

health.physical: Excellent for her age thanks to hiking; mild hypertension, monitored, medicated, unremarkable.
health.mental: Steady and self-aware; the quiet of the house still ambushes her some evenings, which she treats with walks and Brahms.

relationships.name: Antoine and Mathieu
relationships.description: Antoine, in Berlin, keeps sending her links to services 'to make her life easier'; Mathieu in Lyon just asks if she's eating properly. Both mean the same thing.

relationships.name: Denise
relationships.description: A retired pharmacist who tried a meal kit after her husband's diet changed; her meticulous verdict — good portions, uneven vegetables — carries audit-grade weight with Sylvie.

relationships.name: Pierre
relationships.description: The 38-year-old she's grooming to take over; their lunches are half succession planning, half him teasing her about her paper agenda.
